
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><strong>一、方案架构与拓扑设计</strong></p>
<p><strong>1.1 架构总体思路</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">分布式网关</span>VXLAN架构的核心思想是将三层网关功能分散部署在多个Leaf节点上，避免集中式网关的单点瓶颈和次优转发路径问题。在Spine-Leaf组网中，Spine节点负责高速转发和路由反射，Leaf节点同时承担接入层和分布式网关功能，通过VXLAN隧道实现Overlay网络互通。</p>
<p><strong>Spine多活网关</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">的实现关键在于：</span>Spine节点以ECMP方式运行，上行路由设备到指定网段具有等价路由，多台Spine设备同时参与转发，不存在主备概念。当VXLAN网关部署在Leaf侧时，Spine节点不感知VXLAN隧道，仅作为VXLAN报文的转发节点，控制平面只需在Leaf之间建立VXLAN隧道。</p>
<p><strong>M-LAG双活接入</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">将两台</span>Leaf交换机在逻辑上虚拟成一台设备，下联的服务器或交换机通过LACP协议与两台设备进行链路聚合，完全感知不到后端实际是两台设备。M-LAG系统与分布式网关结合后，两台Leaf设备以相同的VTEP IP和网关IP对外呈现，实现真正的双活转发。</p>
<p><strong>1.2 典型拓扑</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌─────────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌─────────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ Spine1 &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ Spine2 &nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ (RR) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ (RR) &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└────┬────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└────┬────┘</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;Underlay (OSPF/BGP) &nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌──────────┴──────────┬──────────┴──────────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌────┴────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌────┴────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌────┴────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;Leaf1 &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;Leaf2 &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;Leaf3 &nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ (M-LAG &nbsp;│==========│ (M-LAG &nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;Master)│ Peer-Link│ Backup) │ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└────┬────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└────┬────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└────┬────┘</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ &nbsp;M-LAG Eth-Trunk &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└──────────┬───────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">┌────┴────┐ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;┌────┴────┐</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│ Server1 │ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│ Server2 │</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">│(双归接入)│ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;│(单归/双归)│</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: 等线">└─────────┘ &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;└─────────┘</span></p>
<p>Leaf1与Leaf2组成M-LAG系统，通过Peer-Link直连（建议采用独立物理链路，带宽不小于所有M-LAG成员口总带宽）。DAD双主检测链路使用独立的三层链路，不能与Peer-Link共用。</p>

<p><strong>关键原则</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>M-LAG主备设备上对应M-LAG成员接口的VLANIF/VBDIF接口必须配置相同的IP地址和相同的虚拟MAC地址。所有Leaf的Loopback1地址在非M-LAG场景下必须全局唯一；在M-LAG场景下，同一M-LAG组的两台设备使用相同的VTEP IP地址。</p>
<p><strong>二、各设备配置范例</strong></p>
<p><strong>2.1 Underlay网络配置（OSPF）</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">以</span>Leaf1为例，配置Underlay三层互通：</p>
<p>text</p>
<p>system-view</p>
<p>sysname Leaf1</p>
<p>interface GE1/0/1</p>
<p>&nbsp;undo portswitch</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 192.168.1.2 24</p>
<p>&nbsp;ospf network-type p2p</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface GE1/0/2</p>
<p>&nbsp;undo portswitch</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 192.168.5.2 24</p>
<p>&nbsp;ospf network-type p2p</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface LoopBack1</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 2.2.2.2 32</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>ospf 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;area 0</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 192.168.1.0 0.0.0.255</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 192.168.5.0 0.0.0.255</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;network 2.2.2.2 0.0.0.0</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>commit</p>
<p>Spine1配置类似，注意Loopback1地址为1.1.1.1/32。验证Underlay连通性：display ospf peer查看邻居状态，ping -a 2.2.2.2 1.1.1.1验证Loopback互通。</p>
<p><strong>2.2 M-LAG配置（Leaf1 / Leaf2）</strong></p>
<p><strong>Leaf1（Master）关键配置：</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>stp mode rstp</p>
<p>stp v-stp enable</p>
<p>dfs-group 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;priority 150</p>
<p>&nbsp;source ip 2.2.2.2 peer 3.3.3.3</p>
<p>&nbsp;dual-active detection source ip 6.6.6.6 peer 7.7.7.7</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface Eth-Trunk1</p>
<p>&nbsp;trunkport GE1/0/3</p>
<p>&nbsp;trunkport GE1/0/4</p>
<p>&nbsp;mode lacp-static</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer-link 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface Eth-Trunk2</p>
<p>&nbsp;trunkport GE1/0/5</p>
<p>&nbsp;mode lacp-static</p>
<p>&nbsp;m-lag 1</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>commit</p>
<p><strong>Leaf2（Backup）</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">对应配置中，</span>DFS优先级设为120，source ip 3.3.3.3 peer 2.2.2.2，其他Peer-Link和M-LAG成员口配置与Leaf1完全一致。</p>
<p><strong>关键注意事项</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>· Peer-Link必须使用独立Eth-Trunk接口，带宽要大于所有M-LAG成员口总带宽</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">必须启用</span>V-STP以避免环路</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">建议</span>Peer-Link成员口不少于2个物理接口，启用静态LACP模式</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">双主检测链路和</span>Peer-Link链路不能共用物理路径</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>2.3 BGP EVPN配置（Leaf1 / Leaf2）</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>bgp 100</p>
<p>&nbsp;router-id 2.2.2.2</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.1 as-number 100</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.1 connect-interface LoopBack1</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.2 as-number 100</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.2 connect-interface LoopBack1</p>
<p>&nbsp;ipv4-family unicast</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.1 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.2 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;l2vpn-family evpn</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.1 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.1 advertise irb</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.2 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 1.1.1.2 advertise irb</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>commit</p>
<p>Spine1作为RR配置：</p>
<p>text</p>
<p>bgp 100</p>
<p>&nbsp;router-id 1.1.1.1</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 as-number 100</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 connect-interface LoopBack1</p>
<p>&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 reflect-client</p>
<p>&nbsp;l2vpn-family evpn</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;&nbsp;peer 2.2.2.2 reflect-client</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>commit</p>
<p><strong>2.4 VXLAN业务接入配置</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>bridge-domain 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;vxlan vni 5010</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface Nve1</p>
<p>&nbsp;source 2.2.2.2</p>
<p>&nbsp;vni 5010 head-end peer-list protocol bgp</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface GE1/0/6.10 mode l2</p>
<p>&nbsp;encapsulation dot1q vid 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;bridge-domain 10</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p>interface Vbdif10</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip binding vpn-instance vpn1</p>
<p>&nbsp;ip address 10.1.10.1 24</p>
<p>&nbsp;mac-address 0000-5e00-0101</p>
<p>&nbsp;vxlan anycast-gateway enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;arp collect host enable</p>
<p>&nbsp;quit</p>
<p><strong>关键配置说明</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>vxlan anycast-gateway enable开启分布式网关功能后，网关收到网络侧的ARP或NS报文将做丢弃处理，只学习用户侧主机的ARP或NS报文。VBDIF接口的MAC地址在M-LAG两台设备上必须配置为相同的虚拟MAC。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">三、</span>M-LAG流量转发机制</strong></p>
<p><strong>3.1 M-LAG核心组件</strong></p>
<p>M-LAG系统由四个核心组件构成：</p>
<p><strong>DFS Group</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">是</span>M-LAG的“大脑”，负责两台设备间的配对、状态协商及表项同步。优先级高者当选Master，负责协调系统行为；Backup设备在正常情况下同样转发流量，没有性能差异。</p>
<p><strong>Peer-Link</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">是</span>M-LAG的“大动脉”，必须是二层Eth-Trunk接口，传输协商报文、同步MAC/IP表项，并在单归链路故障时转发流量。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">双主检测链路（</span>DAD）</strong> <span style="font-family: 等线">是</span>M-LAG的“保命符”。当Peer-Link断开但心跳正常时，备设备自动Error-Down掉M-LAG成员口，防止双主冲突。</p>
<p><strong>M-LAG成员接口</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">直接连接下联设备，被加入</span>Eth-Trunk并绑定到特定的M-LAG ID。</p>
<p><strong>3.2 正常转发流程</strong></p>
<p><strong>同子网已知单播</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Leaf1收到本地下联主机发往同子网远端主机的报文后，查找MAC表，若目的MAC在远端VTEP（Leaf3）上，则进行VXLAN封装后直接通过Underlay转发至Leaf3，不经过Spine节点。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">同子网</span>BUM报文</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：通过</span>EVPN Type 3路由建立头端复制列表，源VTEP将BUM报文复制为多个单播报文，分别封装后发送至各远端VTEP。</p>
<p><strong>跨子网报文转发</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Leaf1收到主机报文后，发现目的IP不在本子网，查找L3VPN实例下的路由表（通过BGP EVPN IRB路由学习获得）。网关在本地完成三层转发，重新封装VXLAN后发送至目的VTEP。两台M-LAG设备使用相同的网关IP和MAC，服务器感知到的网关是唯一的。</p>
<p><strong>3.3 M-LAG故障切换流程</strong></p>
<p><strong>Peer-Link故障</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>DAD链路检测到Peer-Link断开但心跳正常，Backup设备将M-LAG成员口置为Error-Down状态，所有流量切换到Master设备转发。此时下联服务器通过LACP感知到一条链路故障，自动收敛到剩余链路。</p>
<p><strong>Master设备故障</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>Master设备下电或重启后，Backup设备通过DAD心跳超时感知，升为新的Master，接管所有M-LAG成员口，流量切换至新的Master转发。</p>
<p><strong>上行链路故障</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：建议配置</span>Monitor Link关联上行接口和下行接口，当上行出接口Down时，下行接口状态变为Down，防止用户侧流量被丢弃。</p>
<p><strong>Peer-Link故障时Bypass VXLAN隧道</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：在物理</span>Peer-Link场景下，若设备通过M-LAG双归接入VXLAN且接入侧链路故障，业务流量无法直接通过物理Peer-Link接口传输，此时可配置Bypass VXLAN隧道解决。</p>
<p><strong>四、网络调试详细步骤</strong></p>
<p><strong>4.1 Underlay调试</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>1：检查OSPF邻居状态</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display ospf peer brief</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">所有邻居状态应为</span>Full。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>2：验证Loopback互通</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>ping -a 2.2.2.2 1.1.1.1</p>
<p>ping -a 2.2.2.2 1.1.1.2</p>
<p><strong>4.2 M-LAG调试</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>1：检查DFS配对状态</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 m-lag</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">关注</span>Heart beat state（应为OK）和State字段（Master/Backup）。Causation字段为“-”表示配对成功。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>2：检查Peer-Link状态</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 peer-link</p>
<p>display eth-trunk 1 verbose</p>
<p>Peer-Link接口应为Up，成员口状态正常。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>3：检查M-LAG成员口配对</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 m-lag brief</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">确认</span>M-LAG成员口在主备设备上均已配对成功。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>4：检查双主检测状态</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 dual-active</p>
<p><strong>4.3 BGP EVPN调试</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>1：检查BGP EVPN对等体</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display bgp evpn peer</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">所有</span>EVPN对等体状态应为Established。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>2：检查EVPN路由</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display bgp evpn all routing-table</p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">应能看到</span>Type 2（MAC/IP）、Type 3（IMET）和Type 5（IP前缀）路由。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">步骤</span>3：检查VXLAN隧道</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display vxlan tunnel</p>
<p>display vxlan vni</p>
<p>VNI状态应为Up，隧道信息应包含远端VTEP IP。</p>
<p><strong>4.4 常见故障排查</strong></p>
<table border="0" cellspacing="0">

<p><strong>五、注意事项</strong></p>
<p><strong>5.1 M-LAG配置注意事项</strong></p>
<p><strong>Peer-Link配置</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：必须在心跳状态正常时才能配置</span>peer-link，防止一台M-LAG成员设备的接口错误进入error-down状态。如果M-LAG以根桥模式配置，需在接口上禁用STP（undo stp enable）。建议Peer-Link接口成员口采用10GE或更大带宽物理口，成员口数不少于2个，启用静态LACP模式，直连不能加透传设备。</p>
<p><strong>M-LAG成员口一致性</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>DeviceA与DeviceB上的M-LAG接口配置必须完全一致，包括VLAN划分、LACP模式等，否则会导致协商异常。</p>
<p><strong>广播域隔离</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：如果属于不同进程的</span>M-LAG成员端口同属于一个广播域，在peer-link接口被阻塞时可能造成环路，需要划分不同进程的M-LAG成员端口到不同广播域。</p>
<p><strong>配置顺序</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：建议先配置物理</span>peer-link接口以及Bypass VXLAN隧道，待peer-link接口Up之后再配置双主检测source-ip和peer-ip地址。</p>
<p><strong>5.2 分布式网关注意事项</strong></p>
<p><strong>License要求</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：通过</span>BGP EVPN方式部署的分布式网关为VXLAN增强功能，使用License控制，需要申请并购买相应License。</p>
<p><strong>配置一致性</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：请确保两台双归接入设备上关于</span>VXLAN业务接入点和VXLAN隧道的配置保持一致。</p>
<p><strong>ARP抑制</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>BGP EVPN方式支持主机IP路由通告、ARP通告，可直接使能ARP广播抑制功能。在三层网关上开启分布式网关功能后，网关收到网络侧的ARP或NS报文将做丢弃处理，只学习用户侧主机的ARP或NS报文。</p>
<p><strong>主机路由发布</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：根据</span>Overlay网络类型选择发布IRB路由（arp collect host enable）或IP前缀路由（arp direct-route enable）。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">上行口</span>STP处理</strong><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span>VLANIF的上行口需配置stp disable，并将物理Peer-Link端口退出上行口所在VLAN，上行口配置为三层主接口。</p>
<p><strong>六、验证与测试</strong></p>
<p><strong>6.1 基础连通性测试</strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">测试</span>1：Underlay连通性</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">在各设备上执行</span> ping -a Loopback IP 对端Loopback IP，验证Underlay三层可达。</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">执行</span> display ospf peer 确认所有OSPF邻居为Full。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">测试</span>2：VXLAN隧道建立验证</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">执行</span> display vxlan tunnel 确认隧道状态为Up。</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">执行</span> display vxlan vni 确认VNI状态为Up，隧道列表包含正确的远端VTEP IP。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">测试</span>3：EVPN路由学习验证</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">执行</span> display bgp evpn all routing-table 检查Type 2和Type 5路由是否正确学习。</li>
<li>· <span style="font-family: 等线">执行</span> display bgp evpn peer 确认所有EVPN邻居状态为Established。</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>6.2 M-LAG状态验证</strong></p>
<p>text</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 m-lag &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# DFS配对状态</p>
<p>display dfs-group 1 peer-link &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# Peer-Link状态</p>
<p>display eth-trunk 2 verbose &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# M-LAG成员口状态</p>
<p>display m-lag consistency-check &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;# 配置一致性检查</p>
<p><strong>6.3 业务测试场景</strong></p>
<p><strong>场景一：同子网二层互通</strong></p>
<p>Server1（10.1.10.100/24）与Server2（10.1.10.200/24）处于同一子网。Server1 ping Server2，预期正常通信。在Leaf1上执行 display mac-address bridge-domain 10 确认远端MAC地址通过VXLAN隧道学习到。抓包确认报文经过VXLAN封装，在Underlay中传输。</p>
<p><strong>场景二：跨子网三层互通</strong></p>
<p>Server1（10.1.10.100/24）与Server3（10.1.20.100/24）处于不同子网。Server1 ping Server3，预期正常通信。在Leaf1上执行 display ip routing-table vpn-instance vpn1 确认到10.1.20.0/24的路由通过BGP EVPN学习到。验证分布式网关功能：两台M-LAG设备使用相同的网关IP和MAC，ARP应答一致。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">场景三：</span>M-LAG链路故障切换</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在</span>Server1持续ping Server2的同时，手动shutdown Leaf1（Master）的M-LAG成员口。预期Server1通过LACP感知链路故障，自动切换到Leaf2（Backup）的链路，ping丢包在预期范围内（LACP收敛时间）。验证：display dfs-group 1 m-lag 显示Leaf2仍为Backup状态，M-LAG成员口状态正常。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">场景四：</span>Peer-Link故障测试</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">模拟</span>Peer-Link断开（在Eth-Trunk1接口执行shutdown），验证DAD机制是否生效：Backup设备（Leaf2）的M-LAG成员口应进入Error-Down状态。执行 display error-down recovery 查看接口状态。恢复Peer-Link后，接口自动恢复。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">场景五：</span>Master设备整机故障</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">直接将</span>Leaf1（Master）下电。预期Leaf2通过DAD心跳超时感知，升为新的Master，接管所有流量。Server1到Server2的业务应在DAD检测超时后恢复。记录切换时间和丢包数，评估业务影响。</p>
<p><strong><span style="font-family: 等线">场景六：</span>Spine多活验证</strong></p>
<p>Leaf1上执行 display ip routing-table 确认到Spine1和Spine2的Loopback路由均为等价路由（ECMP）。断开Leaf1到Spine1的链路，验证流量自动切换到Spine2，Underlay转发不受影响。</p>
<p><strong>6.4 VXLAN Ping/Tracert验证</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">华为设备支持</span>VXLAN Ping和Tracert功能，可用于端到端VXLAN网络测试。在发起端使能VXLAN Ping功能后，可对VXLAN隧道进行连通性检测。执行VXLAN Ping时指定源VTEP IP和目的VTEP IP，验证VXLAN隧道的端到端可达性。</p>
<p><strong>6.5 大数据包测试</strong></p>
<p><span style="font-family: 等线">在业务测试场景中，建议在服务器上使用大数据包（</span>10000字节以上）进行ping测试，同时在沿途路径设备上配置ACL计数，通过报文数确定丢包点和故障设备</p>

<li>· ‌<span style="font-family: 等线">双活网关配置详解</span><span style="font-family: Arial">‌</span><span style="font-family: 等线">：</span><a href="https://support.huawei.com/enterprise/zh/doc/EDOC1100352676/f1dad88a" rel="noopener nofollow"><span style="text-decoration: underline">(<span style="font-family: 等线">可选</span><span style="font-family: Arial">)</span><span style="font-family: 等线">配置双活网关</span></span></a>‌‌</li>
